artworks.title: The Port of Genoa
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking [proof] on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lakeside scene with sailboats. A figure is fishing from rocks at the water's edge. The view includes the sky with clouds, featuring intricate brushstrokes depicting details of the boats. The color scheme is sepia and black.

artworks.title: The Dream of Saint Peter
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man leaning against a rock or architectural structure, with one hand supporting his head. His other hand rests on his knee. He has a beard and curly hair, and his expression appears contemplative as he looks upward. He is wearing long, flowing robes that drape around his legs and feet. Beside him on the ground is an open book. Above him, the sky shows an angel with wings floating mid-air while carrying a sheet filled with various animal heads. Two more angelic figures hover at the edges of this vision, partially concealed by clouds. In the background, there are rolling hills, a tree, and a body of water.

artworks.title: Louis XIII on Horseback, Receiving Instruction
artworks.medium: engraving from two plates on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with several figures, all depicted in full length. In the center, one individual is riding a horse, positioned facing away from the viewer. This person wears elaborate clothing, including a wide-brimmed hat with a plume. On either side of the rider are two groups of men. To the left, two men stand together; one holds a helmet under his arm, while the other rests his arm across his chest. They are dressed in detailed period attire with ruffled shirts and cloaks. On the right, three additional men are present, similarly dressed in elaborate clothing of the same period. Some of them hold spears or staffs, and they wear hats with various embellishments. The background features a grand architectural setting with classical columns, creating a sense of a formal or ceremonial environment. The scene is enclosed in a decorative border made of columns and ornate molding, with a crest at the top center.

artworks.title: The Rape of the Sabine Women and The Triumph of Two Emperors
artworks.artist: Cherubino Alberti after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.medium: five engravings printed on separate pieces of yellow silk satin backed with heavy paper

artworks.title: The Deluge
artworks.artist: Willem Liefrinck, after Jan van Scorel
artworks.medium: woodcut from two blocks on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological landscape scene with figures interacting with their environment. The scene depicts an ancient world where a river or body of water is teeming with figures in various states of activity. The landscape extends into the background, showcasing a lush natural environment with trees, hills, and constructed elements like ruins or temples featuring columns. The intricate setting is detailed with figures engaged in dynamic movements and gestures, emphasizing harmony with nature. The use of monochromatic lines and shading enhances the graphic qualities.

artworks.title: Academie
artworks.medium: etching in red ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a nude man seated on a stone block. He is in a slouched position with his left arm resting on his thigh, and his right hand is raised to his forehead, partially covering his face. His head is tilted to the side, and his facial features are in shadow, emphasizing the contours of his face. His hair is dark and slightly wavy, falling around his head in an unkempt manner. The man's body is muscular and well-defined, with particular attention to the detailing of his torso and limbs. Resting at his side is a draped cloth, partially covering his lap. The background consists of a simple, textured surface that draws the focus on the figure itself.

artworks.title: Head of a Venerable Man
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red
artworks.description: The image displays a profile view of a person's head and shoulders. The individual faces left, featuring distinct facial attributes like a noticeable nose and a full beard extending downward. Their long, wavy hair covers the back of the head, appearing voluminous. They wear a draped garment reminiscent of classical attire. The background contains diagonal lines creating a textured look, contributing to the portrait's depth. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Standing Apostle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased with Funds from an Anonymous Donor
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing with his head turned slightly to his left. He is dressed in a draped robe and holds a long cylindrical object in his right hand. The background is plain and the image is bordered by a frame.

artworks.title: Silenus
artworks.medium: etching (iron) on laid paper
artworks.description: There is a drawing of cherubs surrounding a central figure seated on a barrel. Several cherubs with wings gather around a larger central figure, who is positioned in a relaxed seated pose on a barrel. The scene is set amongst trees and grapevines, with the cherubs holding grapes and garlands. One cherub is handing a bunch of grapes to the central figure, while others appear to be engaged in playful activities. The line work and shading suggest an etching or engraving technique, and the composition captures a sense of festivity and harmony within a natural setting.

artworks.title: Ludovico Leoni
artworks.medium: etching with engraving with stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a composed expression. He has a full beard and mustache, closely cropped hair, and is wearing a fur-collared garment over a buttoned-up shirt with a large, pointed white collar. The background is stippled with a decorative border around the portrait. Text appears at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Bacchanal with a Dancing Couple in the Center
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a group of figures under a canopy of trees. The perspective is slightly elevated and frontal, with no distinct horizon line due to the dense foliage. The artwork features intricate, fine lines and cross-hatching for detailed textures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. There are figures reclining and seated on the left and more figures under a tree on the right. In the center, two figures are engaged in a dance, with one holding a tambourine. The background is filled with trees and branches, creating a textured natural setting.

artworks.title: Neptune
artworks.artist: Gilles-Antoine Demarteau, after Anicet-Charles-Gabriel Lemonnier, after Raphael
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and beige on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a male figure's upper body, only displaying his shoulders and above. He is holding a wooden staff or trident in his right hand. The man's head is turned to his left, revealing his profile and a stern expression with deep-set eyes gazing into the distance. His facial features are rugged, with a prominent brow and pronounced cheekbones, complemented by a thick, curly beard and equally curly hair. The hair is depicted in waves. His skin is carved to highlight the muscles and expression on his face. The background is a textured, gradient tone that shades from darker on the top to lighter at the bottom. No visible jewelry is present.

artworks.title: Temporalitas Aeternitas
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The image features various figures and objects with a classical aesthetic. There is a muscular figure in the center holding a staff and wearing draped fabric. On the left, another figure appears to be crouching or kneeling, partially covered by fabric. The background includes ornate vases and a small putto-like figure. To the right, there are sculptural busts on a pile of papers and books. The composition is detailed with foliage and drapery, reflecting a scene inspired by ancient mythology or historical narrative.

artworks.title: Jean Dolent
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's head and shoulders. The individual is facing slightly downward with a contemplative pose. The facial features are softly rendered, with delicately drawn eyebrows and closed or downcast eyes beneath a subtle brow. The hair is styled with gentle waves and curls around the head. There is no clothing visible. The background is a dark, textured surface that emphasizes the illuminated features through contrast. The signature of the artist, Eugène Carrière, is present below the image, along with another indistinct signature or text.

artworks.title: Citizen Aubour, Print Publisher
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile from the chest upwards. He is facing to the right with his head slightly tilted down. The man has a pronounced nose and a strong jawline. His hair is styled in a voluminous, wavy manner typical of the 18th century and is lightly colored and powdered. He is dressed in a dark coat with a high collar and a frilled white cravat. The background consists of cross-hatched lines. No objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John and Alice Steiner
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a male figure in a crucifixion pose, with arms outstretched horizontally. The figure's head is tilted downwards, with a bald head and subtle facial features. The body is muscular and detailed, with shadows highlighting the contours of the torso and legs. The man is wearing a cloth draped around his waist. The background consists of a lightly marked grid on a plain, textured paper. The sketch is done in a brownish-red tone.

artworks.title: Capriccio of Antique Ruins with Men Gazing at a Classical Orator
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [working proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a partially ruined classical structure with large stone arches and columns. Figures are seen among toppled architectural elements like columns. The figures are engaging in various activities such as seated positions and gesturing. In the distance, there is a more complete structure visible through the arch, with additional architectural forms like bridges. The horizon is hidden by ruins and vegetation. The etching style is detailed with intricate line work defining textures of stone, foliage, and fabric, creating a monochromatic palette that evokes a sense of antiquity and an archaeological atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Satyr Family and Classical Sculpture
artworks.artist: Giovanni David after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with classical elements. The image depicts various objects and figures set in a natural setting with lush foliage and rolling hills in the background. The central focus includes a sculptural bust atop a column entwined with ivy. Near the bust, there are floral details and a person playing a large circular object. Animals, such as a reclining goat and a partially visible horse, are present. A distant landscape shows small figures and structures, creating a sense of depth and narrative. The artwork showcases intricate detailing and soft shading typical of classical-themed artworks.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Descending a Path near Shepherds
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [working proof]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 18 x 24.2 cm (7 1/16 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two figures. The horizon is high, with faint hills or structures in the distance. The style is detailed with etching or line work, especially in the foliage and figures. One figure is a shepherd with sheep, and another figure is on a donkey with two riders. The color palette is black and gray, highlighting the details. There are lush trees and a palm tree on the right.

artworks.title: Nemi
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large, gnarled tree in the center. Branches extend across the top of the frame. The scene includes distant hills and a village with a tower on a rocky outcrop. Close to the viewer, detailed brushstrokes create boulders, foliage, and two figures. The color palette is primarily gray and sepia. The style features fine lines and meticulous detail, resembling a traditional engraving.

artworks.title: Head of Dr. Robert Binswanger (the Student)
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black
artworks.description: The image features a black and white abstract print of a person's face and part of the head. The face is centered, facing forward, with angular, textured features. The hair is stylized with curved lines. The background shows abstract patterns and shapes, including a leaf or feather-like form. Handwritten words are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Northern Landscape Fantasy Evoking Tivoli
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is towards the upper third of the image, revealing distant hills and a faintly sketched structure. The drawing is made with fine pencil strokes capturing the details of trees, figures, and other elements. The color palette consists of soft sepia tones. In the foreground, there is a gathering of people and animals. Large trees create depth, while faint architectural and natural elements appear in the background. Birds fly in the sky, adding to the scene's tranquility and motion.

artworks.title: Herodias and Salome
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in ochre, brown, and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The person on the left is facing mostly forward with a slight inclination toward the viewer's right, eyes closed, featuring smooth facial features, with long hair flowing over the shoulders, and partly covered by a veil. They hold a platter with a detailed, sculpted head on it. The individual on the right faces forward and slightly towards the left, with wide, expressive eyes looking directly at the viewer. Their hair is styled up with a flower-like accessory placed an inch above the forehead, wearing a garment with flowing sleeves. The background appears simple, with no distinct features, enhancing the focus on the individuals in the foreground.

artworks.title: Herodias and Salome
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in two shades of green and black on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in a stylized and illustrative manner. Both are shown from the waist up. The woman on the left is holding a platter with a bearded man's severed head. She has closed eyes and a contemplative expression, with her hair partially covered by a cloth. The woman on the right stands facing forward, with wavy hair and a decorative cap. She wears a loose, flowing garment with puffy sleeves. An ornate border surrounds them, featuring a banner in the top left corner and a faded coat of arms in the top right. The background is a plain, muted yellow.
